## React (JS + TS)
 - React language server backed by TypeScript with full JSX awareness — completion, diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, rename, signature help and inlay hints
 - Applies to `.tsx`/`.jsx` everywhere, and to plain `.ts`/`.js` only inside a React project so the built-in TypeScript server keeps handling the rest
 - Bundled React TextMate grammars (`source.tsx`, `source.js`, `source.ts`) for accurate JSX/TSX highlighting even before the server connects
 - Built-in runner: open **Run React** from the editor toolbar or the command list
   - Inside a React project it runs your `package.json` dev script (detects npm/pnpm/yarn/bun and installs dependencies on first run)
   - For a standalone `.tsx`/`.jsx` component it creates a throwaway Vite project next to it and starts the dev server
   - Any other script is bundled with esbuild and run with Node
 - Everything runs in the IDE terminal; install the language server once from the Plugin Manager setup action
